headline: As of 2026-10-29: 42,252,629 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 42,252,629 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,019,804), California (4,288,495), Florida (3,928,623).
